assertions.evidence: The plan says to "Use a decision/classification model that outputs probabilities rather than free-form routing text" and describes "a bounded intent decision, not open-ended text generation."

The plan labels examples only as "billing, engineering, or support" and has no explicit none-of-these option; the closest it comes is a low-confidence fallback ("low-confidence cases escalate or send to general support"), which handles uncertainty rather than tickets that fit no team.
